claims.text: Gepotidacin (Blujepa): uncomp urogenital gonorrhea, ≥12 y/o and ≥45 kg, w limited or ⍉alt Tx options
claims.quote: •Uncomplicated urogenital gonorrhea in adult and pediatric patients 12 years of age and older weighing at least 45 kilograms who have limited or no alternative treatment options.

claims.text: Zoliflodacin (Nuzolvence): uncomp urogenital gonorrhea, ≥12 y/o and ≥35 kg
claims.quote: NUZOLVENCE is indicated for the treatment of uncomplicated urogenital gonorrhea due to Neisseria gonorrhoeae in adults and pediatric patients 12 years of age and older, weighing at least 35 kg [see Clinical Studies (14)].
